shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有带盖玻璃瓶、白色薄板和一盏紫外灯，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a lidded glass jar, a few white thin plates and a small UV lamp, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲薄层色谱入门。

shots.scene: 五个步骤图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a jar with a lid, a plate with a pencil line, a jar with a plate inside, a lamp over a plate, and a ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 备缸、点样、展开、显色、计算。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一块薄板，上面用彩色笔写满标记，斑点又大又糊
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a thin white plate covered with pen marks and big smeared spots, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰的薄层板，斑点糊成一片。

shots.scene: 钢笔和大块糊斑图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pen and a large smeared spot, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用钢笔标记，点样又太多。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，递给阿杰一支铅笔和一根细毛细管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing safety goggles, hands the young male student a pencil and a thin glass capillary.
shots.narration: 小研说：每一步都有讲究。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从头学起。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块显出几个斑点的薄层板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a thin white plate with a few small colored spots at different heights.
shots.narration: 薄层色谱是有机实验的常用分析法。

shots.scene: 四个图标：混合物、纯度勾、反应瓶、纯化柱
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a mixture of dots, a purity check mark, a reaction flask, and a purification column. No people.
shots.narration: 鉴定组分、看纯度、跟踪反应和纯化。

shots.scene: 薄层板剖面示意：底层支撑板，上面一层白色涂层
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a thin plate: a backing layer with a thin white coating on top. No people.
shots.narration: 薄层板是在底板上涂一层吸附剂。

shots.scene: 涂层里撒着发光小点
shots.prompt_en: Tiny glowing dots mixed into the white coating of the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 吸附剂是极性的，多数还掺了荧光粉。

shots.scene: 一小瓶细玻璃毛细管
shots.prompt_en: A small vial holding a bundle of very thin glass capillary tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 点样用很细的玻璃点样管。

shots.scene: 市售毛细管和更细的自制毛细管并排对比
shots.prompt_en: A store-bought capillary next to a thinner hand-drawn capillary, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 可以买现成的，也可以自制，更细。

shots.scene: 带盖玻璃瓶、圆形滤纸、量筒中的展开剂
shots.prompt_en: A glass jar with a lid, a round filter paper, and a graduated cylinder with a small amount of clear solvent. No people.
shots.narration: 展开缸：带盖玻璃瓶、滤纸、展开剂。

shots.scene: 镊子、铅笔、直尺摆成一排
shots.prompt_en: A pair of tweezers, a pencil and a ruler laid out in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 镊子、铅笔、直尺也要备好。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手把滤纸滑进瓶里，贴住瓶壁
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slides a filter paper into the glass jar so it lies flat against the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 先把滤纸放进瓶里，平贴瓶壁。

shots.section_title: 倒入浅层展开剂并加盖
shots.scene: 从量筒倒入浅浅一层展开剂
shots.prompt_en: A shallow layer of solvent is poured from a graduated cylinder into the jar. No people.
shots.narration: 倒入浅浅一层展开剂。
overlay: 倒入浅层展开剂并加盖

shots.section_title: 倒入浅层展开剂并加盖
shots.scene: 倾斜瓶子，滤纸被润湿，然后盖上盖子
shots.prompt_en: The jar is tilted so the filter paper gets wet, then the lid is screwed on. No people.
shots.narration: 倾斜润湿滤纸，盖上盖子防挥发。

shots.section_title: 湿滤纸让缸内蒸气饱和
shots.scene: 瓶内充满淡淡的蒸气图标
shots.prompt_en: Faint vapor icons fill the closed jar above the solvent and around the wet filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 湿滤纸让缸里充满溶剂蒸气。
overlay: 湿滤纸让缸内蒸气饱和

shots.section_title: 湿滤纸让缸内蒸气饱和
shots.scene: 板面溶剂蒸发的小箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thin plate with small evaporation arrows leaving its surface, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 展开时板上的溶剂就不会蒸发。

shots.scene: 一叠塑料背衬薄层板，旁边一块玻璃板图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of plastic-backed thin plates, with a small glass plate icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 本课用塑料背衬的板。

shots.scene: 铅笔打勾，钢笔打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pencil with a green check and a pen with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标记只用铅笔，不用钢笔。

shots.scene: 墨迹随溶剂向上跑的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ink mark smearing upward along with the solvent on a plate. No people.
shots.narration: 墨水会溶在溶剂里，一起跑上去。

shots.scene: 板的暗面和光面对比，暗面打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two sides of a thin plate: a dull matte side with a green check and a shiny side with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标记和点样都在暗面。

shots.scene: 放大镜下暗面的白色涂层
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass shows the white coating on the dull side. No people.
shots.narration: 暗面才是涂了吸附剂的那一面。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手指捏住板的两侧边缘
shots.prompt_en: Gloved fingers hold a thin plate only by its two side edges. No people.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，也只拿板的边缘。

shots.scene: 手指按在板中间的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger pressing on the middle of the plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手上的油污会吸在板上，影响结果。

shots.scene: 小研用直尺和铅笔在板底上方画一条细线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, draws a thin straight pencil line near the bottom of the plate with a ruler.
shots.narration: 距底约一厘米，画一条起始线。

shots.scene: 线上画出几个小刻痕
shots.prompt_en: Small tick marks are drawn across the line where samples will go. No people.
shots.narration: 每个点样处画一个小刻痕。

shots.scene: 点太靠边、边上有蒸发箭头，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spot right at the plate edge with evaporation arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 点位别太靠边，边缘蒸发会出偏差。

shots.scene: 两个点挨得太近、展开后重叠，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two spots too close together that merge after running, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 点和点别太近，免得斑点重叠。

shots.scene: 阿杰在废板上反复练习点样
shots.prompt_en: The young male student practices spotting on a spare plate again and again, wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 点样最难，要多练几次。

shots.scene: 三个样品瓶：太淡、适中、太浓
shots.prompt_en: Three sample vials: one almost clear, one lightly tinted, one very dark. No people.
shots.narration: 样品要稀一些。

shots.scene: 太稀看不到斑点，太浓拖成长条
shots.prompt_en: Two plate icons: one with no visible spot, one with a long streaky smear, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 太稀看不见，太浓会拖尾。

shots.scene: 毛细管蘸取样品，轻触刻痕
shots.prompt_en: A glass capillary dips into a sample vial, then lightly and quickly touches the tick mark on the plate. No people.
shots.narration: 蘸一点样品，轻快地点一下。

shots.scene: 稍等后在同一位置再点一次
shots.prompt_en: After a short pause, the capillary touches the same spot again. No people.
shots.narration: 等溶剂挥发再点，一般一到三次。

shots.scene: 毛细管长时间按在板上，斑点扩大，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a capillary pressed on the plate for a long time with a spreading big spot, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 点样管别停太久，斑点会又大又散。

shots.scene: 三个斑点由大到小，最小的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three spots from large to small; the smallest one has a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 直径一两毫米，越小越好。

shots.scene: 小研用镊子夹起薄板，放进展开缸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, picks up the plate with tweezers and lowers it into the developing jar.
shots.narration: 斑点干了，用镊子把板放进缸里。

shots.scene: 缸内液面在起始线下方，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Inside the jar the solvent level sits below the starting line on the plate, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 展开剂液面必须低于点样线。

shots.scene: 液面淹过斑点、样品溶进溶剂，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solvent covering the spots and the sample dissolving into the solvent, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 淹过了，样品就溶进展开剂里了。

shots.scene: 盖上盖子，板站在缸中间
shots.prompt_en: The lid is put back on; the plate stands in the middle of the jar. No people.
shots.narration: 盖好盖子，防止板上溶剂挥发。

shots.scene: 板边贴到滤纸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the plate edge touching the filter paper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 板边别碰滤纸，会扰乱溶剂上升。

shots.scene: 溶剂前沿慢慢上升，斑点分开
shots.prompt_en: The solvent front slowly climbs the plate and the spots separate. No people.
shots.narration: 盯住溶剂前沿。

shots.scene: 前沿离顶端留出一段距离
shots.prompt_en: The solvent front stops a short distance below the top of the plate, with a gap marked. No people.
shots.narration: 离顶端要留出五到十毫米。

shots.scene: 前沿到顶、斑点继续上移的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the front reaching the top while spots keep moving, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太靠顶，比移值就会算错。

shots.scene: 镊子取出板，铅笔立即画线
shots.prompt_en: The plate is lifted out with tweezers, and a pencil immediately marks the solvent front. No people.
shots.narration: 取出后，立刻用铅笔标出前沿。

shots.scene: 一块板上有彩色斑点，眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: A plate with clearly colored spots next to an eye icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有颜色的化合物，直接就能看见。

shots.scene: 紫外灯下板发出绿光，上面有暗斑
shots.prompt_en: Under a small UV lamp in a dark viewing box, the plate glows green with a dark spot on it. No people.
shots.narration: 无色的，放到紫外灯下看暗斑。

shots.scene: 铅笔沿暗斑画圈
shots.prompt_en: A pencil traces a circle around the dark spot on the glowing plate. No people.
shots.narration: 用铅笔把斑点圈下来。

shots.scene: 几个显色剂瓶和染色后的板图标
shots.prompt_en: Several reagent bottles with blank labels and a stained plate icon with colored spots. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外下看不见，还可以用显色剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一块板和公式卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a thin plate and a blank formula card.
shots.narration: 结果用比移值来表示。

shots.scene: 相同条件图标下，同一化合物的斑点高度相同
shots.prompt_en: Two identical plates under the same condition icon, with spots at the same height. No people.
shots.narration: 条件相同，同一化合物比移值一样。

shots.scene: 板的示意：从起点到斑点中心标A
shots.prompt_en: A plate diagram with an arrow A from the starting line to the center of the spot. No people.
shots.narration: A：起点到斑点中心的距离。

shots.scene: 从起点到前沿标B
shots.prompt_en: The same diagram with an arrow B from the starting line to the solvent front. No people.
shots.narration: B：起点到溶剂前沿的距离。

shots.scene: 从板底开始量的箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An arrow measured from the bottom edge of the plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别从板底量，这是常见错误。

shots.scene: 公式图示
shots.prompt_en: A simple fraction diagram with A on top and B on the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 比移值等于A除以B。

shots.scene: 极性化合物斑点低，非极性斑点高
shots.prompt_en: A plate with a low spot marked with a polar icon and a high spot marked with a non-polar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 极性越大的化合物，比移值越小。

shots.section_title: 展开剂极性越大，斑点走得越远
shots.scene: 四块板从左到右，斑点逐渐升高
shots.prompt_en: Four plates from left to right; the spot climbs higher on each one, with an arrow labeled by a polarity icon. No people.
shots.narration: 展开剂极性加大，斑点走得更远。
overlay: 展开剂极性越大，斑点走得越远

shots.section_title: 展开剂极性越大，斑点走得越远
shots.scene: B的箭头长度不变，A的箭头变长
shots.prompt_en: On the four plates the B arrow stays the same length while the A arrow grows longer. No people.
shots.narration: 前沿不变，比移值普遍变大。

shots.scene: 一块板上0.2和0.8两条虚线
shots.prompt_en: A plate with two dashed lines marking a middle zone. No people.
shots.narration: 比移值在零点二到零点八最好分。

shots.scene: 纯非极性溶剂：一个斑点停在底部
shots.prompt_en: A plate developed in a non-polar solvent with one spot stuck near the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 纯正己烷里，只有一个低低的斑点。

shots.scene: 纯极性溶剂：一个斑点冲到顶部
shots.prompt_en: A plate developed in a polar solvent with one spot near the top. No people.
shots.narration: 纯乙酸乙酯里，一个斑点冲到顶。

shots.scene: 混合溶剂：两个斑点分开在中间，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A plate developed in a mixed solvent with two separate spots in the middle zone, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 两者混合，两个斑点就分开了。

shots.section_title: 比较化合物要在同一块板上
shots.scene: 两块板上同一化合物斑点高度略有不同
shots.prompt_en: Two separate plates where the same compound shows slightly different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 不同板之间，比移值会有偏差。
overlay: 比较化合物要在同一块板上

shots.section_title: 比较化合物要在同一块板上
shots.scene: 一块板上并排的几个点打勾
shots.prompt_en: One plate with several spots side by side, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 比较化合物，最好点在同一块板上。

shots.scene: 三个样品瓶：问号、A、B
shots.prompt_en: Three sample vials with a question mark icon, an A icon and a B icon. No people.
shots.narration: 未知物是A、B，还是两者混合？

shots.scene: 两块板，每块三个刻痕
shots.prompt_en: Two plates, each with three tick marks on the starting line. No people.
shots.narration: 两块板，各点三处：未知、已知、共点。

shots.scene: 毛细管在中间和一侧点A
shots.prompt_en: A capillary spots compound A on the middle mark and one side mark of the first plate. No people.
shots.narration: 先在中间和一侧点已知物，晾干。

shots.scene: 毛细管在纸巾上排掉余液，再伸进干净溶剂里洗
shots.prompt_en: The capillary is touched to a paper towel to drain, then dipped into a vial of clean solvent to rinse. No people.
shots.narration: 换样前排净余液，用干净溶剂洗。

shots.scene: 在中间和另一侧点未知物，第二块板换成B
shots.prompt_en: The unknown is spotted on the middle and the other side mark; the second plate is done with B. No people.
shots.narration: 再点未知物；第二块板换成B。

shots.scene: A板共点出现两个斑点
shots.prompt_en: The first plate: the middle co-spot shows two separate spots. No people.
shots.narration: 和A共点，出现两个斑点。

shots.scene: B板三个斑点同一高度，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The second plate: all three spots sit at the same height, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 和B共点，只有一个斑点。

shots.scene: 问号变成B
shots.prompt_en: The question mark icon on the vial changes into a B icon. No people.
shots.narration: 说明未知物就是B。

shots.section_title: 五步回顾，演示不能代替讲义
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁五个步骤图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five step icons light up one by one beside the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 五步走完，还学会了选溶剂和比较。
overlay: 五步回顾，演示不能代替讲义

shots.section_title: 五步回顾，演示不能代替讲义
shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 直视发光灯管的眼睛图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an eye staring at a glowing UV tube, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外线伤眼伤皮肤，别直视灯管。

shots.scene: 小研戴防紫外护目镜，在暗箱里观察薄板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing UV-blocking safety goggles and gloves, looks at a plate inside a dark UV viewing box.
shots.narration: 用暗箱观察，戴防紫外眼镜。

shots.scene: 手指关掉紫外灯开关
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger switches off the UV lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 看完立即关灯，手别长时间照射。

shots.section_title: 展开剂易燃，远离明火热源
shots.scene: 展开剂瓶上的易燃象形图
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a flammable hazard pictogram on its blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 常用展开剂大多易燃易挥发。
overlay: 展开剂易燃，远离明火热源

shots.section_title: 展开剂易燃，远离明火热源
shots.scene: 酒精灯和电热板靠近溶剂瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open flame burner and a hot plate next to a solvent bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 远离明火和热源。

shots.section_title: 展开剂易燃，远离明火热源
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里倒展开剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours developing solvent into the jar inside a fume hood, wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 配展开剂，最好在通风柜里进行。

shots.scene: 量筒量取少量溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A small graduated cylinder holds just a little solvent. No people.
shots.narration: 展开剂够用就好，少量取用。

shots.scene: 倒完立即拧紧试剂瓶盖，敞口瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle cap is screwed back on right away; an open bottle icon nearby is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂瓶随开随盖，展开缸别敞着。

shots.section_title: 用过的板和毛细管怎么扔
shots.scene: 用过的薄板放进固体废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A used thin plate is dropped into a solid chemical waste bin with a pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的板和沾溶剂的纸巾，
overlay: 用过的板和毛细管怎么扔

shots.section_title: 用过的板和毛细管怎么扔
shots.scene: 固体废物桶盖好，旁边垃圾桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The solid chemical waste bin is closed; an ordinary trash can nearby is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 按化学固体废物收集，不进生活垃圾。

shots.section_title: 用过的板和毛细管怎么扔
shots.scene: 毛细管放进碎玻璃收集盒
shots.prompt_en: Used glass capillaries are placed into a broken glass box with a pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 毛细管是玻璃锐器，放进专用盒。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现展开缸和铅笔图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a lidded jar and a pencil.
shots.narration: 缸要饱和，标记用铅笔、在暗面。

shots.scene: 小斑点和低于点样线的液面图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tiny spot and a solvent level below the starting line. No people.
shots.narration: 斑点小、液面低、前沿留余量。

shots.scene: 公式和同板对比图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fraction A over B and a plate with three spots side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 从起点量，同板共点来比较。

shots.scene: 紫外灯、火焰打叉、废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a UV lamp with goggles, a crossed-out flame, and a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 防紫外、远明火、废物分类。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块斑点清晰的薄层板挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a thin plate with neat small spots and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 小小一块板，学问真不少，下次见！
